text: Dipsomania [Gr. diya , thirst, + mania , madness]: Ger. Dipsomanie ; Fr. dipsomanie ; Ital. dipsomania , alcoolofilia ( E.M. ). An uncontrollable craving for alcoholic liquors, together with the abnormal mental symptoms which result from alcoholic excess. See ALCOHOLISM. ( J.J. )
